counterfactual_missing_items: No ANA titer, anti-dsDNA, or anti-Smith results are provided
No malar rash, discoid rash, photosensitivity, or serositis documented
Negative lupus anticoagulant and anti-β2-glycoprotein 1 antibodies weaken isolated APS but do not exclude SLE
decisive_items: symmetric swelling of metacarpophalangeal joints (MCPs) and interphalangeal joints (IPs), preventing fist formation
response.rationale: R5 best integrates the multi-system SLE pattern: inflammatory polyarthritis, alopecia, ulcers, lymphocytopenia, anti-SSA and anticardiolipin positivity, ILD, and interface dermatitis with vasculopathy. R4 is undermined by normal muscle strength, depressed CK, normal aldolase, negative anti-Mi-2, and normal capillaroscopy. R2 lacks sufficient APS criteria and does not explain the broader SLE features. R1 lacks sicca; R3 is only a pulmonary complication.

rejected.why: Only anti-SSA positivity; no sicca symptoms and no raw support spans; does not explain ulcers, alopecia, cytopenia, anticardiolipin, or biopsy vasculopathy.

Positive anticardiolipin alone is insufficient; lacks clinical thrombosis/pregnancy morbidity, with negative lupus anticoagulant and anti-β2-glycoprotein 1; does not explain arthritis, alopecia, lymphocytopenia, anti-SSA, or ILD.
ILD is a complication/pattern rather than a unifying diagnosis; does not address skin, joint, hematologic, or serologic findings.
